title: Siege of Tangier (1463–1464)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Tangier (1463–1464)", at revision 1370745656, opens: "The siege of Tangier (1463–1464) was an attempt by the Portuguese, led by Afonso V of Portugal to capture the city of Tangiers. The expedition ended in failure." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q121282974, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1463 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
